scope: New phase/matter and observation sources only. The preserved Kerr catalogue is separate. Source pedigree is not a validation verdict.

sources.title: Event Horizon Telescope official public data portal
sources.role: Publisher identification and release discovery; the selected 2011-2013 release is historical, not the latest EHT campaign.

sources.title: EHT 2020-D03-01: calibrated M87 2011-2013 total-intensity visibility amplitudes
sources.dataLicense: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (ODC-PDDL)
sources.licenseScope: The full publisher LICENSE.txt is preserved. No publisher analysis script is imported.
sources.role: Actual numeric training and holdout measurements with uncertainties and original row lineage.

sources.title: Wielgus et al., Monitoring the Morphology of M87* in 2009-2017 with the Event Horizon Telescope
sources.role: Primary scientific context for sparse early-EHT amplitudes and geometric morphology modelling. The project's stationary circular fit is simpler than the paper's analysis. Its failure does not replicate or refute that analysis.

sources.title: NIST DLMF 10.9.1: Bessel integral representation
sources.role: Independent angular-quadrature evaluation of J0, independent of the production alternating power series.

sources.title: Stone et al., Athena: A New Code for Astrophysical MHD
sources.role: Primary MHD and constrained-transport methodological reference. The new bounded first-order solver is not Athena and does not inherit Athena's validation results.

sources.title: Aranson and Kramer, The World of the Complex Ginzburg-Landau Equation
sources.role: Neutral phenomenological complex equation family and phase-defect context; not evidence for this project's chosen coupling coefficients or an astronomical matter law.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook: iron condensed-phase thermochemistry
sources.role: Reference heat-capacity/enthalpy data. The project's constant heat capacities and rounded transition constants are a declared approximation, not a full JANAF fit.

sources.title: NIST-hosted reviewed iron thermodynamic compilation
sources.role: Reference for melting scale 1811 K and fusion enthalpy 13810 J/mol. The laboratory still omits pressure dependence, expansion and microscopic kinetics.

sources.title: NIST elemental atomic data: iron
sources.role: Iron atomic weight 55.845 and first ionization energy 7.9024681 eV used in the reference diagnostic. No local LTE assumption is empirically established.

sources.title: EHT 2021 M87 results VII: Polarization of the Ring
sources.role: Primary polarimetric context. These are separate observables; the imported amplitude-only release cannot test a polarization or magnetic-direction model.

sources.title: EHT 2021 M87 results VIII: Magnetic Field Structure Near the Event Horizon
sources.role: Model-dependent plasma/GRMHD interpretation, not direct local density/temperature/field values or acceptance targets for this patch.

currentObservationEvidence.scope: Both stationary circular surrogates fail holdout. This is not a validation of phase/matter/MHD, Kerr gravity, a cover or physical passage.

phaseNumericalEvidence.scope: Representative exported-state conservation/CT checks, smooth scalar and resistive-mode refinement, uniform complex reaction, approximate iron enthalpy and analytic phase windings. First-order spatial numerical diffusion remains significant; no GRMHD, turbulence, high-Mach shock or astronomical calibration verdict follows.
